'''Huruni Hune''' was an [[Actor/Legends|actor]] who starred in the play ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]''<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|life/13418_2.html|Rodian Campaigning Mixes Drama & Politics}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|life/13418_2.html|Rodian Campaigning Mixes Drama & Politics}} is set on the date 13:4:18, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The play, which was performed at a venue known as the [[Equator City First Stage]], was detailed in a review by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] Drama Editor [[Korvit Domesa]], with Hune listed as one of the stars of the show.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huruni Hune was mentioned in "Rodian Campaigning Mixes Drama & Politics," an article<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #52]] on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN" /> on [[April 18]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN52 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072939/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-11#post-6493893}}</ref>
